fix(openfeature): scope invalid activation errors to future opt-out

Preserve valid, missing and invalid activation metadata when preparing
configuration. Reject the affected flag only for a subject with a valid
future-mode cutoff, including malformed unreachable allocations. Other
modes and absent cutoffs retain normal behavior, while schedule decoding
remains strict.

Cover modes, cutoff presence, malformed types, ordinary fallbacks, neighbor
isolation and validity transitions through Remote Config. Full package,
race and 90 pinned Lean policy cases pass; regression tests reject the
previous all-mode quarantine and an invalid-as-missing mutation.

Decision: https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/pull/5700#discussion_r4351454041
